title: Problems and solutions
lead: Today, each way to talk to TYPO3 has a separate implementation. With actions, all ways use one common model.

title: Actions
lead: An action is a public method of a service with the attribute `#[AsAction]`. The signature is the contract, and TYPO3 derives everything else from the signature once, when TYPO3 compiles the dependency injection container.

title: Channels
lead: Each channel shows the example action as its consumer sees the action. No channel needs additional code.

title: Stack
lead: Each layer of the stack has one responsibility. Click a layer for details, or play a scenario to follow a request through the stack step by step.

title: Security model
lead: An app can never do more than the user that the app acts for, and never more than an administrator configured for the app.

title: Use cases
lead: AI assistants, coding agents, integrations, imports, the backend and extensions use the same actions.

title: Screenshots
lead: The screenshots come from a development installation. Click a screenshot to enlarge it.
note: Swagger UI is available in **System › Configuration** (button “API Documentation”) in every installation, because the backend itself uses actions. When EXT:hub is installed, the **API Hub** module also shows Swagger UI.

title: Actions in extensions
lead: A method of your extension becomes an action with an HTTP endpoint, OpenAPI documentation and an MCP tool.

title: Technical details
lead: The diagrams show the request lifecycle and the error handling in detail. Click a diagram to enlarge it.

title: Status and roadmap
lead: The work consists of patches for review on Gerrit, grouped in an epic on Forge. Scripts generate the table of changes from Gerrit and Forge.
